summary: Budgy Smart 4.0 Phase 2 tested in FRONTEND ONLY mode, using the Expo web preview at a 390x844 viewport in local demo mode. PASSING: the entry flow (language > Français > Continuer > Explorer en mode démo); adding expenses with the + modal; the 'Dernières opérations' section with its 'Voir tout' link to /expenses; the eye toggle, which masks every home amount (hero, Revenus/Engagés, Aujourd'hui/Semaine, recent ops) and keeps the setting after a reload via the 'budgy.hideAmounts' key; '% vs mois dernier', which only appears when both months have data (-55% verified); the Dicter quick action, which opens VoiceInputModal; the Dépense quick action, which goes to /expenses; the period selector (‹ goes to Septembre 2026 with the 'Aucune dépense sur cette période' empty state, › comes back and is then disabled, aria-disabled=true); the monthly total; the 'Aujourd'hui' day group with its day total (−77,50); the category chips (filter, toggle, and 'Toutes'); the Quotidien/Pro tabs (the period selector is hidden on Pro); the actions sheet, which opens from both '…' and long-press; savings: creating a goal from the 'Fonds d'urgence' template, after which the gradient summary card appears, and a second + opens /paywall?trigger=manual; Budgy Twin (Plus > Intelligence & projets > Budgy Twin is listed first): with no income it shows the warning and no result; with a 5000 income, 500 gives 'Oui, sans problème' / CHF 4 500, 4900 gives 'Possible, mais juste', and 9000 gives 'Déconseillé' / −CHF 4 000; the breakdown is shown and the switch toggle does not crash; Dépenses stays at 0 items afterwards, so no transaction is created; the Budgy AI modal (3 main actions, then a 'PLUS D'OUTILS' separator, then 3 more; Escape closes it); the 5 Plus categories; light theme stays readable on Accueil, Dépenses and Twin; no page errors and no white screens. FAILING: (1) deleting an expense does not work on the web preview, because Alert.alert with buttons does nothing in react-native-web: no confirm appears, the sheet stays open and the row is not removed; (2) home 'Aujourd'hui' / 'Cette semaine' always show CHF 0, because new Date('28.10.2026') is an Invalid Date; (3) the Budgy Twin BETA badge does not appear in the Intelligence & projets list; (4) the Twin interpolation used {n} instead of {{n}} (FIXED by T1).

ui_bugs.component: Home quick stats Aujourd'hui / Cette semaine
ui_bugs.issue: Always CHF 0 even right after adding expenses today. RCA: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:156-164 uses new Date(t.date), but tx.date is saved as now.toLocaleDateString(locale) ('28.10.2026', expenses.tsx:184). That parses to an Invalid Date, so every filter returns nothing. Fix: use the same parseDate helper as src/stores/selectors.ts:58.

On the web preview, tapping Supprimer does nothing: no confirm dialog appears, the sheet stays open and the transaction stays. RCA: src/components/EntityActionsSheet.tsx:82 and app/(tabs)/savings.tsx:161 use Alert.alert with buttons, which does nothing in react-native-web. It should work on native iOS/Android, which was not tested here. Fix: on web, use window.confirm and call onDelete() when it returns true.
features.ts:47 sets badge 'BETA' on the twin entry, but MenuList in app/(tabs)/more.tsx:253-320 never renders f.badge, so the list shows no BETA badge. It only appears in the Twin screen header.

'Réserve vos versements prévus ce mois ({n})' showed the raw {n}. The translation helper replaces {{key}}, but twin.protectSavingsSub and twin.beforeLabel used {n} in all 4 languages. FIXED by T1 in translations.ts (8 strings); it now shows (CHF 0).

issues: Rounding is inconsistent: the home recent ops show −CHF 46 for 45.50 and Engagés shows CHF 58 for 57.50; the Dépenses summary card shows CHF 78 while the day header shows −77,50 and the rows show -45,50. Use 2 decimals or the same formatter everywhere.
The hero eye button is 28x28 with no hitSlop (index.tsx:650), under the 44pt minimum. The accessibilityLabel always says 'Masquer les montants', even when amounts are hidden.
The '…' button on expense rows is an 18px icon with no hitSlop (expenses.tsx:431-438), and the category chips are about 28px tall. Both are under 44pt.
BrandLogo shows an empty white circle for 'Coop' (duckduckgo favicon 404 for coop.ch); there is no fallback when the image fails to load.
In masked mode, the hero '••••' sits higher than the 'CHF' label (baseline misalignment).
On web, the focused amount TextInput draws a white outline box that runs past the right edge of the card. Add outlineStyle:'none' for web, or limit the input width.
If realAvailableThisMonth is lower than the savings reserve, availableBefore is clamped to 0 (twinSimulator.ts:60). The breakdown rows then no longer add up to the displayed total.

action_items: HIGH: index.tsx:156-164: compute todayExpenses and weekExpenses with the parseDate used by selectors.ts (DD.MM.YYYY), not new Date(t.date).

HIGH: EntityActionsSheet.tsx:82 and savings.tsx:161: add a web fallback (Platform.OS==='web' ? window.confirm(...) && onDelete() : Alert.alert(...)) so deletion works in the web preview. Check other Alert.alert confirm flows too.
MEDIUM: render f.badge (BETA) in MenuList (more.tsx) so Budgy Twin shows its BETA badge in Intelligence & projets.
LOW: use the same precision for amounts (2 decimals) on the home recent ops, Engagés and the Dépenses summary card.
LOW: add hitSlop or a bigger size to the hero eye (28px), the '…' row button (18px) and the category chips; toggle the eye accessibilityLabel (Masquer/Afficher).
LOW: add an onError fallback to BrandLogo when the favicon fails to load; remove the web focus outline on the Twin TextInput.
critical_code_review_comments: Transaction dates are saved as toLocaleDateString(locale), which depends on the locale (an en-US user gets MM/DD/YYYY). This breaks naive new Date() parsing and makes parseDate ambiguous. Prefer ISO dates for storage.
Files over 700 lines: index.tsx (790), expenses.tsx (918), savings.tsx (1016). Consider splitting them.
Very few testIDs on new Phase 2 elements: hero eye, period arrows, chips, recent ops, Twin switch, AI modal actions and More categories have none. Tests had to use aria-labels and text. Add testIDs.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (about 30 of 34 checks passed; 3 open bugs, 1 fixed)

seed_data_creation: None stored anywhere. All data was local demo state in fresh browser contexts; one previous-month tx (TEST_Prev, 15.09.2026) was injected into localStorage to test '% vs mois dernier'. No Supabase account was used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call is a fresh context: redo language > Français > Continuer > 'Explorer en mode démo'. Demo state lives in localStorage 'guardian-money-storage' (zustand persist; tx dates are DD.MM.YYYY), and page.goto keeps it. The add-expense modal inputs use placeholders 'ex: Migros' and '0.00'; the submit button is 'Ajouter'. The incomes modal uses 'Salaire net' and '6500', then 'Ajouter le revenu'. Selectors: AI button [data-testid=budgy-ai-button]; hero eye aria-label 'Masquer les montants'; period arrows aria-label 'Mois précédent' / 'Mois suivant'; Twin input [data-testid=twin-amount-input]. On web the delete confirm (Alert.alert) does nothing.
rca_of_issue: Today/Week CHF 0: index.tsx uses new Date('DD.MM.YYYY'), which gives an Invalid Date. Delete does nothing on web: react-native-web's Alert.alert is empty. Missing BETA badge: MenuList ignores the feature.badge field. Raw {n} in Twin: the translation helper's regex expects {{key}}.
